Fresh Fruit Dips
By: Michelle La Clair
Published: Thursday, February 25, 2010 - 10:27pm

Ingredients




1 (8oz) cream cheese
1 (7oz) jar marshmallow creme

Preparation

1 Combine softened cream cheese and marshmallow creme;  mix until well blended. 2 Serve with fresh fruit and cookies as dippers. 3 You can add 1 tsp orange juice and 1 tsp grated orange rind to mixture.
